comment: WASM strategic inventory. Three roles: PARSER-TARGET (audio decoder compiled to wasm - native parser bugs have wasm twins), CARRIER (wasm smuggled in metadata, SIREN v1 vector), ESCAPE-SURFACE (runtime/compiler sandbox CVEs that turn 'wasm runs' into RCE).

parser_target_packages.name: webaudio-node
parser_target_packages.note: dr_libs compiled to WASM -> CVE-2026-32836 grammar reaches Node/browser pipelines; Emscripten heap exhaustion instead of host OOM-kill, still DoS
parser_target_packages.fingerprint: pre-compiled .wasm in package, strings 'drflac__' inside wasm binary

parser_target_packages.name: @wasm-audio-decoders/flac
parser_target_packages.note: libFLAC not dr_libs - different bug class, but metadata path still parses PICTURE grammar

parser_target_packages.name: @wasm-audio-decoders/mp3|ogg-opus|aac
parser_target_packages.note: codec-parser front-end parses container metadata in JS before wasm decode - JS-side length handling is its own surface

parser_target_packages.name: @ffmpeg/ffmpeg (ffmpeg.wasm)
parser_target_packages.note: full ffmpeg in wasm worker; worker memory limits turn parser OOM into worker crash/restart churn

parser_target_packages.name: sndfile-wasm / waverly / wafl
parser_target_packages.note: libsndfile-to-wasm ports; check libsndfile version for CVEs

parser_target_packages.name: libflacjs / flac.js
parser_target_packages.note: older libFLAC emscripten ports in long-tail packages

carrier_channels.note: SIREN v1 vector - wasm magic 00 61 73 6d survives padding, extractor can instantiate
extractor that sniffs real type may hand bytes to a wasm loader
wasm carried as attachment; polyglot container bridge

escape_surface_cves.class: wasm-import signature type confusion -> arbitrary R/W -> native code exec in content process
escape_surface_cves.relevance: any pipeline that instantiates attacker wasm in Firefox-derived runtimes

escape_surface_cves.class: try_table JSTag catches host-realm exception below JS sanitization layer -> host Function -> RCE
escape_surface_cves.relevance: LLM/sandbox plugins using vm2 to run untrusted code that may embed wasm

escape_surface_cves.class: compiler-backend sandbox escapes - miscompiled bounds checks give host read/write
escape_surface_cves.relevance: server-side wasm ingestion of untrusted modules, incl. audio-decoder plugins
AI code-exec sandboxes that also process audio uploads

hunt_queries: npm: 'wasm audio decoder flac' / 'dr_libs wasm' / 'webaudio-node' dependents
npm package scan: any package shipping .wasm >100KB with 'flac|mp3|vorbis|aac' strings
pip: packages bundling .wasm (pyodide-based audio tools, pydub-wasm)
